svg.title: Where tasks go as the budget grows
svg.desc: Where do the tasks that pass at a small budget go at a bigger one? Of 92 tasks passing at tokens-0, 70 still pass at tokens-200000.

g.text: Where do tasks go as the budget grows?
The 160 tasks every run shares, from the smallest budget to the largest. Each ribbon is a group of tasks moving
